Clinical Extern - Professional Practice
Req #864
Posted Friday, November 6, 2026 at 12:00 AM | Expires Friday, November 20, 2026 at 11:59 PM
WCH is offering an exciting opportunity for Nursing students to come join our team as a Clinical Extern. In this role you will have the opportunity to work in a revolutionary organization supporting a skilled team of experienced nurses and health disciplines in the provision of ambulatory care.
Temporary Clinical Extern position, up until March 31, 2027
Hourly Rate: $20.60
Maximum of 7.5 hours per week
Position type: Temporary Part-Time, Clinical Extern (RN)
Enrolled in an accredited degree (Bachelor of Science in Nursing)
Completion of Basic Cardiac Life Support (B.C.L.S.) required.
